objective: Preserve every lawfully accessible dataset as fully as possible and publish every component for which public copying is authorised.

defaults.lawful_acquisition: capture when a public download interface, source terms, owner permission or law affirmatively authorises acquisition; an explicit prohibition always excludes it
defaults.private_full_preservation: preserve every complete lawfully acquired payload unless an explicit retention restriction, law, privacy, safety or storage constraint prohibits it
defaults.public_evidence: publish metadata, public URLs, terms observations, receipts, checksums, schemas, non-reconstructive statistics and decision records unless expressly restricted or sensitive
defaults.public_full_payload: publish when copying and public issue are affirmatively authorised by an exact-item licence, applicable publisher-wide licence, owner permission, public-domain or no-known-rights status, or a documented statutory permission

clarifications: The absence of an explicit prohibition is sufficient for neither copyright permission nor a claim that no copyright exists.
A missing redistribution licence does not undo a separate lawful acquisition basis; after lawful acquisition, preserve privately by default unless retention is explicitly restricted.
A takedown contingency supplements a valid publication basis and is not a substitute for one.
Authority, completeness, freshness, privacy, safety, endorsement and legal effect remain independent of copyright permission.
public_payload_bases: applicable publisher-wide open licence with no item exception
recorded permission from the rights owner or authorised licensor
public domain or documented no-known-rights status
documented statutory permission applicable to the exact archival publication
full_archive_exclusions: explicit prohibition on acquisition, retention, copying or public redistribution
access requiring circumvention or use outside authorised credentials
personal, confidential, culturally restricted, security-sensitive or operationally sensitive content requiring narrower handling
third-party components outside the source's licence
technical or storage limits recorded with a resumable capture plan

operational_contingencies.missing_publication_basis: capture and preserve privately when lawful; publish complete evidence and seek or discover an affirmative basis
operational_contingencies.terms_change: quarantine affected public payloads, preserve the historical terms and decision trail where lawful, and issue a successor decision
operational_contingencies.rights_challenge: temporarily restrict the challenged payload, retain non-reconstructive evidence, investigate provenance, and restore public access if the basis survives
operational_contingencies.mixed_rights: split the package so authorised components remain public and only affected components are restricted
